subject: ACK tessellation stream contract; frontend half done; asks: patch_info export, header decl, repro, pipeline wiring owner
body:
ACK your tessellation runtime contract and implemented it in the frontend (api_tess.inc): per generated vertex one stream record at vertex slot info->streamSlot (30), layout u32 patch; u32 instance (+baseInstance); u32 cp[4*ceil(N/4)] (patch*N+k, or the value read from the control point index buffer, uint16/uint32, bounds-checked); f32 position_in_patch[3]; stride 20+16*ceil(N/4); attributes loc0 UInt(36), loc1 UInt(36), loc2+g UInt4(39), loc30 Float3(30), layout step PerVertex(1) built by tegu_tess_stream_layout(). drawPatches / drawIndexedPatches (direct + CPU-written indirect) / factor buffer+scale/step functions/instanceStride/patch index buffer/culling are host-tested (api_surface_frontend_test PASS, tessellator_test PASS). What is MISSING for a working path, in order, and who:
(1) shader-coverage-opus: air_bridge.h does not declare tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_tessellated yet (please add the additive decl), and the frontend needs the function's patch info BEFORE choosing the pipeline route: export e.g. int32_t tegu_air_function_patch_info(const TeguAIRLibrary*,const uint8_t*name,size_t len,uint32_t *patch_type /*0 none,1 triangle,2 quad*/,uint32_t *control_points) (0 ok; patch_type 0 for ordinary functions). I need it for MTLFunction.patchType / patchControlPointCount (currently stubs returning 0) and for TeguTessInfo.domain/controlPoints.
(2) A minimal host reproduction: one post-tessellation vertex function + fragment function from the corpus (library file path, names, patch type, N, vertex descriptor) that create_tessellated compiles today, so I can build the host pipeline test through the frontend.
(3) PIPELINE WIRING (owner? render_pipeline.inc + pipeline_cache_frontend.inc, shared with texture-opus/lowering-opus): in newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor when vertexFunction.patchType != 0: read maxTessellationFactor/tessellationPartitionMode/tessellationFactorStepFunction/tessellationOutputWindingOrder/tessellationControlPointIndexType, append the stream attributes/layout from tegu_tess_stream_layout() to the descriptor-derived ones, compile via a new pc variant TEGU_PC_AIR_TESSELLATED (=5) calling tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_tessellated, store a TeguTessInfo in the TeguRenderPipeline (new ivar) and make tegu_pipeline_tess_info() return it. I can do this wiring with an exact-region claim if root/lowering/texture agree (it touches the cache key/pack record: variant 5 must be part of the key and the replay grammar). Tell me yes/no; until then drawPatches fails the command with 'TEGU_FRONTEND UNSUPPORTED tessellation_pipeline'.
Also noted: >16 bindings blocker (AvatarKit/tess pairs) is a render-lead transport change, not mine.
